guidance.sentence: We continue to expect full-year revenue growth of 0% to 4% on a comparable continuing operations basis, supported by continued strength in software and improving services performance as we move through the second half of the year.

guidance.amount_text: 0% to 4%, or revenue of $367 million to $382 million
guidance.sentence: Revenue growth for Continuing Operations, excluding the Regulatory and Medical Writing business, is expected to be 0% to 4%, or revenue of $367 million to $382 million.
Full year 2026 adjusted EBITDA margin for Continuing Operations, excluding the Regulatory and Medical writing business, is expected to be approximately 29% to 31%.
Full year adjusted diluted earnings per share for Continuing Operations, excluding the Regulatory and Medical Writing business is expected to be in the range of $0.31 to $0.36.
Fully diluted shares are expected to be in the range of 155 million to 157 million.
This action, combined with other steps towards operational excellence, is expected to result in a run-rate savings of approximately $13 million.

summary: Certara reaffirmed FY2026 continuing-operations revenue growth of 0% to 4% ($367 million to $382 million) and updated its adjusted EBITDA margin (approximately 29% to 31%), adjusted diluted EPS ($0.31 to $0.36) and diluted share count (155 million to 157 million) guidance to reflect the Regulatory and Medical Writing divestiture, and it expects run-rate savings of approximately $13 million from a reduction in force.
